subject: Upside validation & stage tidy for Q4 expansion opportunities
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Upside validation & stage tidy for Q4 expansion opportunities

Team —

Quick request ahead of Friday's ops commit: we need to validate the upside in the Q4 numbers and tidy stage assignments for a handful of expansion deals where CS ownership is material to conversion. Primary asks:

1) Confirm ACME (ACME-2026-EXP-03) stage and committed amount. AE notes show a +$120k upside but CS has open onboarding questions — we should mark as PROBABLE only if both sides confirm readiness to buy and start in Jan.
2) Run stage hygiene on any deal with "needs-implementation-check" tag — move to "Onboarding" only when CS sign-off documented.
3) Drop any stale upsell opportunities without activity in 45 days into "Assess" for forecast exclusion.

I've attached a short checklist (stage-cleanup-checklist.pdf) and a pivot of the deals I flagged (ACME_MOP_v2.xlsx). Please:
- Marissa: update ACME's committed amount and add notes to the HubSpot deal by EOD Thursday.
- Monica: confirm onboarding readiness items with your CS lead and reply in-thread with a single status line (Ready / Needs follow-up / Low confidence).
- Connor: if any deals should be excluded from the commit, call them out so FP&A can adjust the roll-up before the Friday commit meeting.

Why this matters: our forecast accuracy metric is sensitive to staged expansions this quarter — we want to avoid overstating revenue while still surfacing genuine upside for leadership.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_MOP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB), stage-cleanup-checklist.pdf (doc, 12KB)

Rachel —

Quick status on CS readiness for the deals you flagged:

ACME (ACME-2026-EXP-03): Needs follow-up. Customer has one remaining security questionnaire item (data retention SLA) and wants final clarification on on-prem vs. VPC options. CS lead (Jin) is aligned to finish answers by Thu EOD. I won't mark as "Ready" until we have their confirmation and the signed SOW.

Horizon Labs (HORIZ-2026-EXP-01): Ready — onboarding checklist complete, tech kick-off scheduled for 1/6.

Two smaller upsells (internal tags: needs-implementation-check): both Low confidence — no recent activity in 6+ weeks, recommend moving to Assess.

I'll post the specific CS notes to the HubSpot timeline after the call with Jin on Thursday.

—Monica

Thanks for the heads-up — updated the HubSpot record for ACME with the current committed amount at $120,000 as a conditional upside (note: contingent on signed SOW and security confirmation). I also attached a cleaned MOP sheet (ACME_MOP_v2.xlsx) that includes the timeline Marissa previously shared with the customer.

A couple of clarifications:
- If CS marks "Needs follow-up," I propose we move ACME to "Committed - Contingent" in our internal forecast (exclude from hard commit).
- If Jin confirms by Thu that the remaining security question is purely informational and the SOW is inbound, we can flip to PROBABLE for the Friday commit.

Connor — I flagged two deals that look stale and suggested moving to "Assess"; please review and confirm.

Marissa Cole

All —

Summary for the Friday commit:

ACME (ACME-2026-EXP-03): Marked as PROBABLE @ $120,000 in the forecast roll-up. Monica confirmed the security Q&A was answered and Acme expects a PO once the SOW is updated; Marissa will attach the final draft SOW to HubSpot. Please note this is PROBABLE (not hard commit) and FP&A should treat it as upside.

Next steps: Marissa — attach the final SOW and update HubSpot by EOD Monday. Monica — confirm PO receipt in-thread when it arrives so we can flip to hard commit. Connor — please send the final list of excluded deals to Finance for the roll-up.

Thanks everyone for the quick turn — this should clean up the forecast and keep leadership expectations grounded heading into the commit.
